caption:
Retatrutide may be the strongest weight-loss medicine yet, and it is not approved anywhere 🔬 It acts on three gut hormone receptors at once (GLP-1, GIP and glucagon) and is still in final-stage trials. Retatrutide sold online is not the trial medicine, and nobody checks what is inside.
